notes.title: Update notes for version 1.11
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Secret code for a future demo
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to a full inventory
[*] Fruit tree rates fixed
[*] Fixed visual number bug cooking while selecting items
[*] Wings costume fixed
[*] Fixed a sound bug using the inn door
[/list]

I am also working on a future free expansion. It is progressing slowly but I hope to bring you more news soon.

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.1
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added music during the day
[*] New confirmation system when quitting the game or starting a new game.
[*] New message system in the form of windows every time you craft a tool
[*] New windows when you level up the first level of something important explaining what you get from each level
[*] New on-screen requirements system to make it easier to know what the repair spots or NPCs are asking for.

[/list]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the first Nira will always be visible after recovering the power
[*] Text improvements to give more hints to players
[*] Improvements to make clearer how to finish the game if you go through the texts too fast
[*] A silhouette is now shown in the special crop guide

[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple problems with fullscreen
[*] Reduced collision of cows
[*] Watering can full text when filling the watering can
[*] Good ending didn't remove required items
[*] Bad ending could not be replayed
[*] Sell didn't show quantity on some items
[*] Fabricating had stopped working with the mouse in v1.05
[*] Fixed buggy manufacturing issue since v1.05
[*] Version flag was not being saved when saving the game
[*] Fixed positions using controller in the last tab of the options menu
[*] Multiple minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.05
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now see the amount of money you will earn when selling.
[*] In the bomb mini-game there is a new progress bar
[*] In the bomb mini-game the bosses have a lifebar
[*] Steam Cloud support
[*] Support for multiple controllers connected at the same time
[*] Built-in language switching in the options menu
[/list]
[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now launches in fullscreen the first time you open the game to make it work better on the Steam Deck
[*] Added option to quit the game without going into options in the main menu
[*] User teleporting when loading the game after a new patch to avoid data loading issues
[*] Improved some jokes
[*] Icons for inventory and options are now visible also for controllers so users know they exist without having to try them out
[*] Already crafted items now disappears from the crafting list
[*] Now hats applies automatically when you buy them
[*] Improvements in some menu texts
[*] The nightlamp craft is now unlocked earlier so that less users will miss it
[*] The save function now have a "saving" text to let users know that the cat hand is the save function
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed fishing bug
[*] Fixed double milk bug on cows
[*] Fixed bug with hats when changing maps
[*] Fixed bug in new game
[*] Fixed bug text "you don't have the required items" in the second Nira
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of life improvements and screenshots feature
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pressing F12 will save screenshots in the game folder
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved collisions in farm and town maps
[*] Better collisions for trees, now you can gather them from a side
[*] Smaller collisions for chickens and farm signal
[*] Better jokes for some item descriptions
[*] Improved arrow tutorial for farming at the start of the game
[*] Bunyi hints improved
[/list]
[b]Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players getting out of bounds on the farm. If game detects a problem will reset the scene.
[/list]
